snippet.title: For The Love Of Retro Reloaded - Episode 22
snippet.description:
Our New Retro Games Reviews present Absolute Zero and amazing platform puzzle game for Amiga, InfeZtation a run’n’gun platform game for the Commodore 64 and the amazing “O” for the ZX Spectrum Next!
This week also we introduce a new section to our show, so we welcome our Retro Adventuring segment, and we begin by reviewing the amazing Snarl, a point and click horror adventure game, Paranoid a new thriller text-adventure and in our retrospect adventure game review Quest for Glory IV: Shadows of Darkness.
Our Hardware review takes a closer look at the Sinden Light Gun and the DOS Vault opens to let us review Slipspeed, an incredible futuristic top-down racing game and we remember the often-underestimated FPS Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold.
Lastly, in our History Lesson, we learn about the Japanese invasion of the MSX and why it failed to conquer the world of computing.
